measure_description: Measured with utils/measure script using 2 identical lamps connected in parallel (MULTIPLE_LIGHTS=true, NUM_LIGHTS=2) on a Shelly Plus 1PM, because a single lamp draws below the meter's resolution floor. Reported values are per lamp. The lamp is CCT only (supported_color_modes: color_temp), so color_temp is the only mode measured. Measurement starts at brightness 2: at brightness 1 the meter consistently read 0 W for both lamps combined. The session was interrupted once by a Zigbee coordinator queue overflow and completed via resume, so voltage_range reflects the later part of the run.
name: FLAIR Viyu A60 E27 CCT Bulb (8.5W, 806 lm)
